name: Bramble-Through Owlbear

Actions.name: Claw
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. 17 (3d8 + 4) Slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) Poison damage.

Actions.name: Briar Flail (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw*: DC 14, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. *Failure:* 27 (6d8) Piercing damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn. *Success:* Half damage only.
Actions.clause: The owlbear tears its thorn-studded forearm free in a wide, low sweep, flinging severed briar-segments in an arc before
Actions.expresses: bramble-vines grown through its hide and bone

lore: A bear-owl that wandered into a fey-haunted thicket and was claimed by it, the bramble-owlbear now drags a living hedge of thorn-vines through its own flesh, hunting the forest edge to spread its seeds wherever it bleeds.

generation.userConcept: a thing like an owlbear but grown through with brambles
generation.cite: composition after Ogre (CR 2) — one colossal hit, no traits

monsterDescription: a thing like an owlbear but grown through with brambles
